run_implicitron_evaluator: run the ImplicitronEvaluator to evaluate a trained model on a test dataloader and return metrics
create_evaluator_base_subclass: create a subclass of EvaluatorBase to implement custom model evaluation logic with a run method
dump_evaluation_results_to_json: dump evaluation results to a JSON file using the _dump_to_json helper function
mask_target_frame_data: mask target image data in frame data using _get_eval_frame_data to prevent cheating during evaluation
review_implicitron_evaluator_run: review the ImplicitronEvaluator run method to understand how LPIPS metrics and batch evaluation are computed
